_comment: Single control surface for the autonomous loop. Change `mode` to walk the safety rollout ladder. See scripts/ralph/README.md.
_mode_values: dry-run = do everything up to the local gate, then only report (no push/merge/deploy) | pr-only = commit+push+open PR, never merge/deploy | full-auto = merge to main + deploy + auto-rollback (objective-gated)
_maxFailures: consecutive gate failures before the loop halts and writes a report (anti-thrash backoff)
_maxIterations: iterations per loop run before stopping cleanly
_discoverEvery: run a discovery iteration (refill the backlog) every N work iterations, and when the backlog is empty
_deployRelevantAreas: areas whose changes require a green `pnpm eval` before full-auto deploy
_notify: send a PushNotification at end-of-run and on a blocked/halt state
